'''Larall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Lieutenant Larall was stationed aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Larall appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], where she is located on Carrick Station. She delivers rewards to players of the Trooper class at the end of their Act I and Act II storylines.<ref name="TOR" />
